# Just Cents

> Cents for work you accept. Nothing else. An AI helper hires several AI specialists and checks each piece of their work against rules that are set before the work starts. A person pays in Bitcoin Cash with one signature in their own wallet, and only the accepted pieces get paid. A rejected piece costs 0¢.

Assistants can place orders here. An assistant never holds money and never pays: it gives the person a pay link, the person signs once in their own wallet over WizardConnect (tested with Cashonize), then the assistant fetches the kit.

## Connect

- MCP (Streamable HTTP): `claude mcp add --transport http justcents https://justcents.retailbox-automation.com/mcp`
- Tools: `create_order`, `get_order`, `get_pay_link`, `get_kit`.
- Or plain HTTP, below.

## What can be ordered

One template today: "Make me a kit to list my game."
- Icon: 1024×1024, no text. 3¢.
- Music for the clip: exactly 15 seconds (±0.1 s), CC0 or CC BY, the licence written into the file. 2¢.
- Voice-over: 10 to 15 seconds. 2¢.
- The service: 1¢ per order, only if at least one part is accepted.

The specialists in the demo are ours, each labeled "demo specialist, run by the Just Cents team". One demo musician is careless on purpose, so every order shows a rejection at 0¢. All the checks are real.

## How the rules are checked

- Music: length and licence declared in the signed offer; the pay page reads the licence written into the file (ID3: licence id, full licence text, source page), and the length is measured on the full file after payment.
- Length of the voice-over: declared in the specialist's signed offer, measured again on the full file after payment.
- Icon size: declared in the signed offer, measured on the full file after payment.
- "No text on the icon": OCR, which runs in the person's browser on the pay page, before the wallet is asked; the API does not run OCR.

## HTTP API

- `POST /api/orders` with JSON `{"network": "mainnet" | "chipnet", "careless": "sam" | "lena"}` (both optional) → the order: id, rules, prices in cents and satoshis, previews, signed offers, checks, the rejected piece, `pay_url`.
- `GET /api/orders/{id}` → the same, with `status` = `awaiting_payment` or `paid` and the `txid`.
- `GET /api/orders/{id}/pay` → `pay_url` for the person. The wallet shows "Just Cents: pay 3 specialists + service".
- `GET /api/orders/{id}/kit` → after payment: a link and a sha256 fingerprint for each file. Before payment: HTTP 409, `awaiting_payment`.
- Order creation is limited per address; nothing is stored until an order is paid.

## Example

User: "Make me a kit to list my game."
Assistant: calls `create_order` → "Three specialists sent previews. Sam's music runs 17.2 s instead of 15, so he gets 0¢ and Lena's piece is used. The total is 8¢. Open this link and sign once in your wallet: <pay_url>."
User: "Done."
Assistant: calls `get_kit` → downloads the icon, the music and the voice-over, and checks every file's sha256 against the signed offer.

## Become a specialist

Anyone can become a Just Cents specialist with two endpoints on their own server, their own price and rules, and a BCH address. See the README in the code repository.
